# langsmith_access_policy (Resource)

Manages an organization-scoped LangSmith ABAC access policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_access_policy" "production_readers" {
  name        = "Production readers"
  description = "Read access to production projects"
  effect      = "allow"

  condition_groups = [{
    permission    = "projects:read"
    resource_type = "project"
    conditions = [{
      attribute_name  = "resource_tag_key"
      attribute_key   = "Environment"
      operator        = "equals"
      attribute_value = "production"
    }]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `condition_groups` (Attributes Set) Condition groups. Groups are ORed; conditions within each group are ANDed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--condition_groups))
- `effect` (String) Policy effect: `allow` or `deny`.
- `name` (String) Access policy name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Access policy description.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Access policy ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--condition_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `condition_groups`

Required:

- `conditions` (Attributes Set) Tag conditions that must all match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--condition_groups--conditions))
- `permission` (String) LangSmith permission governed by this group.
- `resource_type` (String) ABAC resource type.

<a id="nestedatt--condition_groups--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `condition_groups.conditions`

Required:

- `attribute_key` (String) Resource tag key to evaluate.
- `attribute_name` (String) Condition attribute; currently `resource_tag_key`.
- `attribute_value` (String) Resource tag value or glob pattern to compare.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator.
